title: String Functions
instructions: C keeps string tools in a toolbox called <string.h>. Include it to use them.
- strlen(s) — how many letters are in s.
- strcat(a, b) — glue b onto the end of a.
- strcpy(dest, src) — copy src into dest.
- strcmp(a, b) — returns 0 when the two strings are exactly equal.
You must #include <string.h> at the top to use them.
task: Add the strcat call that glues 'World' onto 'Hello ' so it prints:  Hello World
